dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of State officials, specifically the Assistant Secretary for the Bureau of African Affairs and the Coordinator for Counterterrorism, as well as congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of State shall direct the Assistant Secretary for the Bureau of African Affairs and the Coordinator for Counterterrorism to carry out a one-year pilot program

dimensions.assessment: Imposes administrative reporting and notification requirements for foreign assistance programs without altering underlying foreign aid authorizations or funding levels.
dimensions.evidence: requires such officials to submit to the appropriate congressional committees a notification of information

dimensions.assessment: Does not authorize new federal funding or alter spending levels, applying instead to programs utilizing additional funds under existing law.
dimensions.evidence: for new and existing foreign assistance programs... that require funds that are in addition to funds made available... under existing law

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a focused, temporary pilot program requiring specific reporting elements for select foreign assistance programs.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a one-year pilot program that requires such officials to submit... a notification of information

dimensions.assessment: Operates specifically as a one-year pilot program.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a one-year pilot program

missing_information: Estimated administrative workload or cost for compiling the 14-point notification elements.
importance_detail.rationale: The Transparency in Foreign Assistance Act establishes a one-year pilot program requiring detailed congressional notifications for specific foreign assistance programs managed by the Bureau of African Affairs and the Coordinator for Counterterrorism.
